subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept this repository-owned pack-and-smoke script as the new `dist-runtime-build` artifact producer?
rationale: The code path is a focused fix with strong proof, but it changes CI artifact production that downstream proof workflows depend on, so accepting that operational risk is a maintainer merge choice.

options.title: Land with exact-head artifact proof
options.body: Merge once the current head or merge queue keeps `build-artifacts` green with pack, manifest, ACP import, and Gateway `/readyz` proof.

options.title: Refresh proof after script changes
options.body: If the workflow or artifact script changes again before merge, require a fresh artifact-producing CI run before accepting the risk.
